morning3_start.name: {name}
morning3_start.text: *Day three. I overslept and shut off my alarm three times. I stayed up too late reading messages last night.*

morning3_start_2.name: {name}
morning3_start_2.text: *I sprint down the road to school. — The school gate comes into view. And then.*

morning3_seo_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_1.text: *Seoyeon is standing in front of the gate. Not in any hurry.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_warm_1.text: *Unlike usual, she's waiting at the gate.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_2.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_warm_2.text: ...I didn't come early. Student council business.

morning3_seo_gate_warm_3.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_warm_3.text: *Her hands are empty. No papers, no clipboard.*

morning3_seo_gate_warm_4.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_warm_4.text: *She starts walking first. After a few steps, she checks that {name} is following and slows her pace.*

morning3_seo_gate_4.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_4.text: So what if we're late. Beats getting scolded alone.

morning3_seo_gate_5.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_5.text: Pretty sure that's not how it works.

morning3_seo_gate_6_b.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_6_b.text: *She walks on. Confidently. She doesn't rush, even though she's late.*

morning3_seo_gate_7.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_7.text: *She walks ahead. Confidently. She doesn't rush, even though she's late.*

morning3_seo_gate_cold_2.name: Seoyeon
morning3_seo_gate_cold_2.text: ...Transfer student. Still coming to school, huh.

morning3_seo_gate_cold_3.name: {name}
morning3_seo_gate_cold_3.text: *Her tone is businesslike. Seoyeon walks past the gate, her back getting smaller.*

morning3_yuna_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_1.text: *I spot Yuna standing blankly in front of the gate. Her eyes are half-closed.*

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_1.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_1.text: *Yuna is leaning against the wall by the gate. She hands me a note.*

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_3.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_3.text: *I unfold the note. 'I waited for you.'*

morning3_yuna_gate_warm_4.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_warm_4.text: *I walk beside Yuna. The only sounds are the crinkle of the bread bag and our footsteps.*

morning3_yuna_gate_5.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_5.text: ...I had to know the ending. I couldn't stop.

morning3_yuna_gate_6.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_6.text: *The kind of person who stays up all night reading and arrives late. Without a word, Yuna rummages through her bag, breaks a small bread roll in half, and offers me a piece. I glimpse a note inside her bag.*

morning3_yuna_gate_6_b.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_6_b.text: *The note reads, 'You didn't eat breakfast, did you?' A little lavender ink has smudged onto the bottom of the bread bag.*

morning3_yuna_gate_7.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_7.text: *She pulls a small bread roll from her bag. We share it as we slowly walk through the gate.*

morning3_yuna_gate_cold_1.name: Yuna
morning3_yuna_gate_cold_1.text: *She walks past first. Our eyes meet, but she turns away.*

morning3_yuna_gate_cold_2.name: {name}
morning3_yuna_gate_cold_2.text: *Her pace quickens. — It feels like the wall is going back up.*

morning3_dain_gate_1.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_1.text: *Near the gate, Dain comes sprinting at full speed.*

morning3_dain_gate_warm_1.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_warm_1.text: *She runs up and links her arm with mine.*

morning3_dain_gate_warm_2.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_warm_2.text: Yo! You almost made us late! Come on, let's go!

morning3_dain_gate_warm_3.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_warm_3.text: *Dain loops her arm firmly through mine. After a few steps of being pulled along, I match her stride.*

morning3_dain_gate_3.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_3.text: *She grabs my hand without warning and starts running.*

morning3_dain_gate_4.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_4.text: Wait — why are you holding my hand?

morning3_dain_gate_4_b.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_4_b.text: This is faster! Don't question it!

morning3_dain_gate_5.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_5.text: *My hand is burning. Is that sweat, or is it just hot where she's holding it? No time to figure it out while sprinting.*

morning3_dain_gate_5_b.name: {name}
morning3_dain_gate_5_b.text: *The moment we cross the gate, Dain lands with a soft "oof." But when I look, she's grinning like nothing happened. — Did I mishear?*

morning3_dain_gate_cold_1.name: Dain
morning3_dain_gate_cold_1.text: *She runs past with her other friends.*

morning3_classroom_1.name: {name}
morning3_classroom_1.text: *As I enter the classroom, Seoyeon's pen stops and Dain's chair slides back. Yuna marks the same page twice.*

morning3_react_seo_1.name: Dain
morning3_react_seo_1.text: Wait, you came in with the council president? First thing in the morning?

morning3_react_seo_2.name: Yuna
morning3_react_seo_2.text: *She turns her gaze from the window and briefly looks toward {name}. Then she turns back to the window.*

morning3_react_yuna_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_yuna_1.text: Walking to school together now? Cozy.

morning3_react_yuna_1_b.name: Dain
morning3_react_yuna_1_b.text: *She walks straight back into the classroom.*

morning3_react_yuna_2.name: Dain
morning3_react_yuna_2.text: I'm jealous! I don't have anyone to walk to school with in the morning.

morning3_react_yuna_2_b.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_yuna_2_b.text: *She stops in front of the classroom door.*

morning3_react_dain_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_react_dain_1.text: Morning workout wore you out. Want my lunchbox at lunch?

morning3_react_dain_2.name: Yuna
morning3_react_dain_2.text: *She draws a short line on the corner of the page without lifting her head.*

morning3_date_intro.name: {name}
morning3_date_intro.text: *First period ends. Someone comes to talk to me during every break.*

morning3_date_intro_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_intro_b.text: *I step into the hallway for break. Seoyeon is the first to fall into step beside me.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_1.text: *Break time. The sound of a pen scratching in the empty classroom. The homeroom teacher sits at the teacher's desk. The pen stops when I appear at the door.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_3_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_3_b.text: *The teacher's hand stops over the manuscript paper. A moment later, the sheet is turned over.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_4.text: ...It's nothing. Work documents. — ...Being observant is usually a strength. Sometimes it's a weakness.

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_b.text: *Dense handwriting shows between the overturned pages. The homeroom teacher's palm covers one corner.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_c.text: *Her expression settles back into its usual indifference. The manuscript remains face down.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_d.text: ...What are you staring at? Why are you even here during break?

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_e.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_e.text: *Manuscript paper. Dense handwriting. The teacher turns the page face down. — Should I ask, or pretend I didn't notice?*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_f.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_f.text: *I can't take a single step. On the desk: attendance book, grade files, student record envelopes, one after another. The teacher's hand is still on the manuscript paper.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_g.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_g.text: *Red pen marks show through the flipped manuscript paper. Two characters: 'On hold.' The moment I see it, the teacher's fingertips press the paper harder.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_4_h.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_4_h.text: *I could have pretended not to notice. The teacher doesn't cover the paper. Closes the pen cap, then opens it again.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_choice.text: *It's manuscript paper. She covers the edge with her palm.*
choices: I saw it's manuscript paper. — Are you writing a novel?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1.text: ...It's too rough to call a novel, but I've been at it too long to call it practice. Seven years.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_c.text: Seven years. *She looks out the window.* I started in college. I majored in creative writing.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_e.text: After graduating, I submitted it a few times. It was rejected. After that... filling out job applications felt easier.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_1_f.text: *The teacher lifts a sheet of manuscript paper. It's covered in dense handwriting.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2.text: The day I was waiting on the last result, the call never came. That same day, I filled out an application to teachers' college.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_b.text: I thought I'd put it away once I got a job. But every time I moved drawers, it came along.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_c.text: So it made it all the way here.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_d.text: *She presses her lips together, then lets out a short sigh.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_e.text: ...It's easier if I think of it as just paper.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_2_f.text: *She toys with the manuscript page, then leans back in her chair.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3.text: That's how I became a language arts teacher. Funny, isn't it? I'm still holding on to these pages.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_3_c.text: *She sets the manuscript page down, one beat late.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4.text: It'd be easier to say I moved on. But I keep pulling this out in empty classrooms — so I guess I never really did.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_b.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_b.text: *Every edge of the manuscript paper is worn from handling. The teacher rests her fingertip on an empty line.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_c.text: *She composes herself.* It's something I was writing on my own. It has nothing to do with class, and you don't have to read it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_d.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_d.text: Am I not allowed to read it?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_e.text: You can read it. I just won't slip it to you in secret. I'll start by getting it ready for the literature club's group critique.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_f.text: *Even after saying that, the teacher cannot take her hand off the manuscript paper.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_g.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_4_g.text: When you share it there, I'd like to read it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice.text: *Seven years. The manuscript paper on the desk is worn thin.*
choices: Seven years isn't giving up — that's persistence
Why do you always write here?

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_a.text: *She falters, her hand going still on the manuscript.* ...Calling it persistence makes it feel a little less pathetic.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_choice_b.text: ...The classroom is the quietest place. Ironic, isn't it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_5.text: I'm planning to show it to the other language arts teachers this week too. If I keep hiding it, I don't think I'll ever finish it.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6.text: *The teacher smiles. Her hand is still on the manuscript paper.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_b.text: ...Then it'll be the first time I've put it in front of anyone in seven years.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_c.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_c.text: *She gives an awkward laugh. The ticking clock grows louder in the empty classroom.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_d.text: *She smiles faintly.* If you hadn't asked, I might have put it away again. Thank you.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_e.text: *She presses her thumb into the corner of the manuscript, crumpling the paper slightly.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_f.text: Because it's quiet here. Still, from now on, let's only talk about the manuscript during literature club.

hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_g.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d3_reveal_6_g.text: *The clock ticks loudly in the empty classroom. My eyes won't leave a sentence covered in layers of eraser marks.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_hide_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_hide_1.text: All right. Let's leave it closed for now. When I'm ready to share it, I'll tell the literature club first.

hidden_homeroom_d3_end.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_end.text: *She closes the manuscript and opens the window beside the lectern. Noise from the hall drifts in, then fades.*

hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.text: *She slips the manuscript pages into a folder.* I understand why you're curious. But let's save this conversation for literature club.
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.context: Day 3 morning. In an empty classroom, a student found the homeroom teacher's personal novel manuscript. She does not ask the student to keep it secret or give private feedback; she is considering submitting it for an open critique at the literature club.
hidden_homeroom_d3_freetalk.personality: The homeroom teacher once hoped to become a novelist. She never stopped writing after becoming a teacher, but she tries to keep her private creative work separate from her role in teaching and evaluating students.

hidden_nurse_d3_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_1.text: *Even after the morning bell rang, I couldn't get up from my seat. The edge of the bandage on my hand is lifting. I open the infirmary door.*

hidden_nurse_d3_1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_1_b.text: *She looks up.* ...Hm? Where are you hurt today?

hidden_nurse_d3_1_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_1_d.text: Not hurt but coming to the nurse's office?

hidden_nurse_d3_1_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_1_e.text: ...I just wanted to rest a bit.

hidden_nurse_d3_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_2.text: ...Then why did you come? You don't look okay.

hidden_nurse_d3_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_2_b.text: *The turned-over manuscript paper and the low voice follow me into the hallway.*

hidden_nurse_d3_2_c.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_2_c.text: *I leave the classroom — and from behind, quietly.*

hidden_nurse_d3_2_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_2_e.text: *Just before lunch. The hallway is noisy, but it doesn't register. The smell of disinfectant from the infirmary door still clings to my wrist.*

hidden_nurse_d3_3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_3.text: ...I just wanted to rest. Relationships are getting complicated.

hidden_nurse_d3_3_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_3_d.text: *The nurse sets down her cup. Her easy movements from a moment ago go still. I sit on the bed.*

hidden_nurse_d3_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_4.text: *She draws the curtain and hands me a cup of water.* ...Sit down. You can relax in here. Take your time talking.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_c.text: ...Something like that? Then it's good you came here.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_d.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_d.text: *At the word 'similar,' the nurse's hand pauses over the cup.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_e.text: ...Things that are hard to bring up with anyone.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_f.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_f.text: *She pulls up a chair and sits across from me.* Relationships.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_g.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_g.text: I'm interested in all three, but I think I'll have to decide on one person in the end.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_k.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_k.text: *She smirks.* Pretending it isn't is the biggest giveaway.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_m.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_m.text: Does this count as school health care...? *She props her chin on one hand.* I'll listen anyway. The bed is free.

hidden_nurse_d3_5_n.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_5_n.text: Have you ever felt that way? Torn between multiple people?

hidden_nurse_d3_5_o.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_o.text: *The nurse pauses. Her gaze drifts to the window.*

hidden_nurse_d3_5_p.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_5_p.text: ...Yeah. Back when I worked at the university hospital.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_a.text: ...Similar? Then it's good you came here.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice1_b.text: *She tilts her head slightly.* ...Right. Complicated or not, just rest here for a bit.

hidden_nurse_d3_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6.text: When I worked at the university hospital, if several call bells rang at once, I found myself counting the empty beds first. I hated that.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_b.text: *The nurse sets down the cup. A ring of moisture spreads beneath it.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_c.text: ...I wouldn't say I quit. I left. *She smiles faintly.* There was no noble reason.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_d.text: *Her hand brushes the stethoscope and starts toward the notebook drawer, then stops.*

hidden_nurse_d3_6_e.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_6_e.text: ...There was. One patient I couldn't save. *Her gaze goes distant.* Seventeen years old. That's what brought me here.

hidden_nurse_d3_6_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_6_f.text: *I remember the pale green notebook from yesterday. The letter that stopped on its first page.*

hidden_nurse_d3_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_7.text: That's why I came here. At school — I can actually give each person proper attention.

hidden_nurse_d3_7_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_7_b.text: *The school nurse looks at {name}. Her expression is serious.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_8.text: Same goes for you. Don't try to take care of everyone at once. — Wouldn't it be better to truly see the one person who matters most?

hidden_nurse_d3_8_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_8_d.text: If it's this hard to carry, don't keep it to yourself. I can connect you with the counseling center if you need it.

hidden_nurse_d3_8_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_e.text: *I fold the information card with the counseling center's number and put it in my pocket.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_f.text: *I rise, then stop at the door. A drawer opens behind me. I picture the corner of the pale green notebook.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_g.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_g.text: *The bandage on the back of my hand has peeled up slightly. The curtain sways between the bed and her nameplate. The words 'School Nurse' stand out with unusual clarity.*

hidden_nurse_d3_8_h.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_8_h.text: *I let go of the door handle and turn back. Paper folds inside the open drawer.*

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2.text: *The nurse stops at 'one person.' The rim of the paper cup buckles beneath her fingers.*
choices: Is that why you left the hospital?
Are you okay talking more about it?

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_a.text: Yeah. If I'd stayed any longer, I thought my hands might start shaking in front of another patient.

hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_choice2_b.text: ...Yeah. I'll only say as much as I can handle.

hidden_nurse_d3_9.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9.text: You're welcome to come here. But I can't promise I'll solve everything for you on my own.

hidden_nurse_d3_9_b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_b.text: *She sets down the paper cup and nods.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9_c.text: If things get harder for you, I'll work with your homeroom teacher or the counseling center.

hidden_nurse_d3_9_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_9_d.text: And before that, you and I will decide who to tell and how much.

hidden_nurse_d3_9_e.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_e.text: *The nurse slides the counseling appointment sheet to the front of the desk.*

hidden_nurse_d3_9_f.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d3_9_f.text: *The sheet lists the nurse's office and counseling center hours side by side. She circles one open slot.*

hidden_nurse_d3_11.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_11.text: You'll be late for your next class. Let's leave today's conversation here for now.

hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.text: *She draws the curtain halfway and pulls over a chair.* Counseling first, jokes later.
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.context: Day 3. The student came to the infirmary for formal counseling after relationships became complicated, and the school nurse shared her experience of burnout at a university hospital. She keeps her experience separate from the student's burden.
hidden_nurse_d3_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is an experienced medical professional with an easygoing sense of humor. She can discuss her burnout without making the student responsible for her recovery and maintains professional boundaries.

morning3_date_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_seo_1.text: Free this weekend? There's somewhere I want to go.

morning3_date_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
morning3_date_seo_choice.text: *She asks casually as she passes me in the hallway.*
choices: I might be kind of busy.

morning3_date_seo_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with Seoyeon.*

morning3_date_seo_accept_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_accept_b.text: *I head back to the classroom. One class passes, and another short break arrives.*

morning3_date_seo_decline_b.name: {name}
morning3_date_seo_decline_b.text: *I head back to the classroom. One class passes, and another short break arrives.*

morning3_date_dain_1.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_1.text: Hey! What are you doing this weekend? Want to hit the arcade?

morning3_date_dain_2.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_2.text: *Her fingers are tapping the edge of the desk. Faster than usual. The chair legs scrape the floor in short bursts.*

morning3_date_dain_choice.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_choice.text: *She comes over during the next break and asks.*

morning3_date_dain_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with Dain.*

morning3_date_dain_decline.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_decline.text: Oh? Yeah, no, if you're busy, no biggie!

morning3_date_dain_decline_narr.name: Dain
morning3_date_dain_decline_narr.text: *She walks away with a bright smile. Just before the bell rings, she taps the inside of her pocket once with her finger.*

morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.name: {name}
morning3_date_dain_decline_inner_2.text: *I always thought I read people well. — And I keep getting it wrong when it actually matters.*

morning3_date_yuna_1.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_1.text: *Just before lunch, a note from Yuna is waiting on my desk.*

morning3_date_yuna_2.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_2.text: *'Weekend. Going to the used bookstore. Come if you want. — Yuna'*

morning3_date_yuna_accept.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_accept.text: *I accepted the weekend plans with Yuna.*

morning3_date_yuna_decline.name: {name}
morning3_date_yuna_decline.text: *I quietly folded the note and put it in my pocket. I didn't write a reply. Yuna lowers her head slightly and closes the book.*

morning3_set_multiple.name: {name}
morning3_set_multiple.text: *My weekend plans overlap. The calendar square is split three ways.*

morning3_end.name: {name}
morning3_end.text: *Classes roll on, and before long, lunchtime approaches.*
